pictures.scene: Benvenuto Tisi da Garofalo, The Ascension of Christ — the risen Lord carried up in the opened light above the watching apostles, the LORD reigns, He is robed in majesty, the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength
pictures.name: pd_garofalo_majesteit

pictures.scene: Asher Brown Durand, In the Woods — the old trunks standing rooted over the stream in the deep green of the forest, the world indeed is firmly established, it cannot be moved
pictures.name: pd_durand_wereld

pictures.scene: Masaccio, The Holy Trinity — the Father standing behind the cross with the dove between, the whole built up under its painted vault, Your throne was established long ago, You are from all eternity
pictures.name: pd_masaccio_troon

pictures.scene: Joseph Anton Koch, Der Schmadribachfall — the whole mountain water coming down the rock in white falls into the valley, the floodwaters have risen, O LORD, the rivers have raised their voice
pictures.name: pd_koch_vloed

pictures.scene: Simon de Vlieger, Der Sturm — the ships heeling over in the grey running sea under a torn sky, the seas lift up their pounding waves
pictures.name: pd_vlieger_zeeen

pictures.scene: Hendrik Willem Mesdag, In der Brandung — the fishing boat riding in through the heavy surf with its crew at the sheets, above the roar of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea
pictures.name: pd_mesdag_golven

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of an Imaginary Catholic Church — the great nave opening away under its vaults with the people quiet in the light, Your testimonies are fully confirmed, holiness adorns Your house, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_witte_huis

pictures.scene: Meindert Hobbema, The Watermill — the old mill with its wheels turning on water that keeps coming down day after day, for all the days to come
pictures.name: pd_hobbema_dagen

lines.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty;
the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength.
The world indeed is firmly established;
Your throne was established long ago;
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD;
the rivers have raised their voice;
the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Above the roar of many waters—
the mighty breakers of the sea—
the LORD on high is majestic.
holiness adorns Your house, O LORD,
for all the days to come.
